program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time, seed, state }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const mass = inputs.mass; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const t = Math.max(0, time); const height = Math.max(0, launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t); const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const acceleration = -gravity; const force = mass * gravity; let motionState = "Ready to toss"; if (t > 0 && t < apexTime - 0.05) motionState = "Rising"; else if (Math.abs(t - apexTime) <= 0.05) motionState = "At the top"; else if (t > apexTime + 0.05 && height > 0) motionState = "Falling"; else if (height <= 0 && t > 0) motionState = "Back at launch height"; const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 20, y: 15, w: 290, h: 360, title: "The Motion", state: motionState })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.height", { x: 50, y: 340, length: 260, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, label: "Height", unit: "m" })); const ballY = 340 - (height / 2.2) * 260; objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", 150, ballY, 28, { role: "observed" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: 170, y: ballY }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, minLength: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: 195, y: ballY }, { value: acceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, minLength: 12, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(215, ballY - 30, ["v: " + sdk.format(velocity) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(acceleration) + " m/s^2", "Fg: " + sdk.format(force) + " N"], { id: "callout.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 330, y: 15, w: 290, h: 360, title: "Velocity over Time", state: "v = u - g t" })); const points = sdk.sample((curT) => launchSpeed - gravity * curT, 0, Math.min(1.8, 2 * apexTime), 20); objects.push(sdk.plot("plot.vt", { x: 350, y: 60, w: 250, h: 220, axes: { x: { label: "Time", min: 0, max: 1.8, unit: "s" }, y: { label: "Velocity", min: -5.5, max: 5.5, unit: "m/s" } }, series: [{ label: "v(t)", kind: "line", points: points.map(([xt, yt]) => ({ x: xt, y: yt })) }] })); objects.push(sdk.text("plot.vt.note", 360, 310, "Slope a = -g", { role: "neutral" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: objects, readouts: [{ id: "velocity", value: velocity }, { id: "acceleration", value: acceleration }, { id: "force", value: force }, { id: "motionState", value: motionState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed, gravity, mass, apexTime, apexHeight, height, velocity, acceleration, force } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but acceleration remains -g and gravitational force is mg. Mass changes force, not motion.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side panels show a tossed ball on a height ruler with velocity and acceleration vectors, alongside a velocity-time graph showing constant slope -g.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare readings near the top.
